does_not_establish: that any recovered theory fits data
that any lead is historically novel
that any theory is complete or publication ready
establishes: exact coverage of all 279 latest-campaign concepts sidelined without an empirical loss
an active empirical and theory next step for every retained audit family

dual_grade_policy.rule: A theory grade never overwrites an empirical grade. Only undefined outputs, dimensional incoherence, non-reproducibility, leakage, or an exact contradiction inside the declared domain may block an empirical diagnostic before data.
